correctness.rationale: The stated macroscopic map is the exact binomial expansion of the 3-person local-flip rule. In signed coordinates its coefficient is affine in independent uniform variables and odd under joint reflection. The conditional variance polynomial (9-6x+5x^2)/24 has maximum 3/8 on 0<=x<=1, implying L2 and almost-sure decay and stationary-law uniqueness. Continuous nondegenerate coefficient distribution gives nonzero finite iterates and independent fair signs. Uniform square-integrable logarithms and a martingale strong law justify the almost-sure exponent log(3/2)-3/2, evaluated by the triangular density of abs(1-a-b). Exact rational checker verified 2217 finite algebraic instances, plus a 180000-step illustrative logarithmic sample; the infinite claims are proved analytically.

originality.rationale: The exact result is for a fresh, common two-coordinate uniform environment at each update round. Toth--Galam 2021 classify fixed deterministic parameters, while Toth 2022/2024 treats randomly selected static parameter vectors across models and their fixed-point/stability distribution. The 2023 propaganda-forced contrarian model is a different asynchronous and temporally driven interaction rule. Model-specific full global convergence, iid majority signs, sharp L2 factor and the exact logarithmic exponent were not found in searched primary results or the published-findings index. This is a best-knowledge originality judgment, not a uniqueness proof; a plausible random-map generalization remains a risk.
residual_risks: Complete full text and appendices of the 2022/2024 random-parametrisation paper could not be obtained for the scientific comparison; relevant portions were available through public indexing.
An equivalent specialized result could appear in uninspected older iterated-random-map literature.
The theorem assumes common roundwise environmental draws and does not extend to individual-group independent randomization or finite-population systems.

value.rationale: The uniform-parameter variant is a motivated temporal counterpart to a published static random-parameter opinion model. It exactly shows how independent common-environment refresh extinguishes persistent polarization while majority *direction* remains unpredictably fair, despite 1/9 of frozen parameter draws being locally expanding. A sharp global L2 coefficient, a closed almost-sure exponent, and an iid-majority-sign theorem are mathematically distinct, testable structural facts not provided by ordinary one-step expected-value averaging.
